limits: operator new is a native heap allocation stand-in.
operator delete is a native heap release stand-in.
realloc is a scripted native CRT allocation boundary; cases preserve copied bytes and allocation lifetime.
lstrlenA is a scripted Windows string-length boundary.
InterlockedDecrement is a scripted Windows atomic decrement boundary.
Original realloc failure faults inside the saved-EBP diagnostic read at address 4; the ordinary comparison does not certify that fault outcome or unreachable normal-return continuations.
Only the 11 listed registration entries are owned; parent registrations and callback bodies remain unchanged original dependencies, and callback addresses are stored as data.
The read-only logic_state_registry_core bridge is linked through shared_sources without transferring ownership of its functions.
notes: Boundary-reviewed against all 11 original disassemblies and bootstrap call sites: cdecl, no arguments, void. Shared core platform fixtures and diagnostic compiler contexts are retained unchanged; no game fixture is declared.
